stock.description: Pizu Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company primarily focused on the manufacture, trade, and distribution of civil explosives within the People's Republic of China and Tajikistan. Its operations are divided into two main divisions: Mining Operation, and Explosives Trading and Blasting Services. The company also furnishes specialized blasting solutions and markets mineral concentrates. Furthermore, Pizu Group engages in mineral exploration and provides associated technical expertise, alongside the extraction and processing of various ores, including pyrite, iron ore, copper, and molybdenum. It also participates in the mining and commercialization of nonferrous metal products, in addition to offering comprehensive mining and subcontracting services. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, the company adopted its present name in May 2012, having previously been known as China Electric Power Technology Holdings Limited.
